actual_review_scope: Read both full four-paragraph editorial bodies, both references lists and disclosure paragraphs, and independent KO/EN titles and separate summary fields in editorial-metadata.json.
Compared central claims with actual selected primary reading recorded in source-audit-spin.json, including pp18–20/Table2 and AppendixA pp26–27; visually checked primary Table2 and Table3.
Read the actual Oct3 VQE §12/13 and relevant KO/EN/publication title/author metadata, rather than inferring continuity from keywords.

Compared KO/EN scientific targets, versions, numbers, cost assumptions, fidelity reference, nonconvergence, QPE repetition and evolution/QEC costs, citation mapping and scoped verification disclosure.

science_checks.singlet_and_large_block_spin: PASS: overall S=0 can couple nonzero subsystem spins; opening does not identify local orbital spin with total spin.
science_checks.reduced_tensor_loading_then_CG: PASS: relabeling, block loading and spin-coupling-based return to occupation basis are in source order and correctly distinguish reduced data from known geometric factors.
science_checks.CG_fraction: PASS after correction: <0.2% refers to basis transforms; full transform includes readout/projection updates, not merely an isolated rotation.
science_checks.135_and_4_9: PASS: Fe4S4 same DMRG-state comparison, not equal-fidelity or physical runtime. Source table gives new4.09e6, dense5.52e8 and U1 2.00e7 Toffolis.
science_checks.cost_model: PASS after correction: 15-bit rotation precision, Toffoli-specific minimization with no ancilla cap, and as-published dense baseline excluding later real-tensor saving are stated.
science_checks.fidelity_and_convergence: PASS: truncation fidelity is relative to a larger reference MPS; exact ground-state fidelity is not established; Fe4S4 missed specified DMRG energy convergence.
science_checks.complete_cost: PASS: QPE repetitions plus downstream time evolution and error correction are required before interpreting cheaper preparation as a full calculation benefit.
science_checks.scope: PASS: no physical QPU execution, original DMRG/Qualtran reproduction, paper-proof validation or human-reader study claimed; independent related preprint not scientifically compared.

editorial_checks.opening_and_explanation: PASS: physical situation (singlet with large subsystem spins) establishes why symmetry can save loading; unfamiliar objects connect to orbitals, reduced tensors and occupation-state reconstruction.
editorial_checks.existing_article_continuity: PASS: Oct3 §12 explicitly discusses target overlap, initial-state preparation, time evolution and physical error correction. New text adds a concrete symmetry-preserving loader without altering that earlier body.
editorial_checks.title_and_separate_summary: PASS: both titles name spin symmetry/state preparation cost; each separate summary gives the reader the reduced-loading-to-QPE-cost relationship and is not an archive-work report.
editorial_checks.bilingual_parity: PASS: claims, model, comparison, numerical conditions and bounded interpretation correspond; prose is natural in each language.
editorial_checks.APS: PASS: source1 all3authors, exact original title, arXivv1 and no eprint date; source2 existing author/date/wording confirmed, EN reference sentence case corrected. Reference order1then2 matches first citation.
editorial_checks.authorization_boundary: PASS: routine short bilingual DQB editorial; no new deep-review proposal, priority change, article expansion or publication approval inferred.
